description.en: Community Sopro V2 Turbo (samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo): a 120M zero-shot voice-cloning TTS. SentencePiece text tokenizer, style-prefix conditioned autoregressive semantic LM over FSQ tokens, rectified-flow acoustic DiT and a Vocos ISTFT vocoder at 24 kHz.
description.zh: 社区 Sopro V2 Turbo（samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo）：120M 零样本音色克隆 TTS。SentencePiece 文本分词器、基于 FSQ token 的风格前缀条件自回归语义 LM、rectified-flow 声学 DiT 与 24 kHz 的 Vocos ISTFT 声码器。

language.en: Language tag (en, pt, fr, de); omitted inherits transcript language, then the session default.
language.zh: 语言标签（en、pt、fr、de）；省略继承转录语言，然后会话默认。

temperature.en: Semantic sampling temperature; nonpositive selects greedy decoding. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.temperature.
temperature.zh: 语义采样温度；非正选择贪婪解码。省略使用检查点生成.温度。

top_p.en: Semantic nucleus cutoff; values outside [0,1] are disabled/clamped by the sampler. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.top_p.
top_p.zh: 语义核切断； [0,1] 之外的值被采样器禁用/钳位。省略使用检查点生成.top_p。

top_k.en: Semantic top-k; nonpositive disables filtering. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.top_k.
top_k.zh: 语义top-k；非正数禁用过滤。省略使用检查点 Generation.top_k。

num_inference_steps.en: Positive acoustic sampling steps; omitted uses checkpoint generation.steps.
num_inference_steps.zh: 正声学采样步骤；省略使用检查点生成.steps。

seed.en: Non-negative seed for semantic sampling and the acoustic noise prior; omit for a random seed.
seed.zh: 语义采样与声学噪声先验的非负随机种子；省略时随机。

max_duration_sec.en: Positive maximum segment duration; must be >= min_duration_sec. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.max_seconds.
max_duration_sec.zh: 最大分段时长，必须为正且 >= min_duration_sec；省略时使用检查点 generation.max_seconds。

min_duration_sec.en: Nonnegative minimum duration; must be <= max_duration_sec. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.min_seconds.
min_duration_sec.zh: 最小分段时长，必须非负且 <= max_duration_sec；省略时使用检查点 generation.min_seconds。

reference_duration_sec.en: Positive reference window in seconds; omitted uses checkpoint generation.ref_seconds.
reference_duration_sec.zh: 参考窗口时长（秒），必须为正；省略时使用检查点 generation.ref_seconds。

text_chunk_size.en: Positive codepoint budget per segment; omitted uses checkpoint generation.max_segment_chars.
text_chunk_size.zh: 每个分段的码点预算，必须为正；省略时使用检查点 generation.max_segment_chars。

sizes.basis: size=tree@hf/HEAD; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_memory=n/a; est_vram=n/a
size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)
